resources.string: Semi-furnished 1-bedroom apartment in Aurora Hill, Baguio City. It comes with a bed, a dining table and kitchen cabinets, and gets plenty of morning sun. Pets are allowed. There is no on-site parking, but street parking is nearby. Long-term and month-to-month contracts are available. A short walk to jeepney stops and a public market.

Fully furnished 2-bedroom apartment in Trancoville, Baguio City. It has a sofa set, beds, a refrigerator, a stove and a washing machine, so you can move in right away. Pets are not allowed. Comes with an on-site parking slot. Long-term and fixed-term contracts are available. Close to schools, a church and a supermarket.

Unfurnished 1-bedroom apartment in Leonila Hill, Baguio City. A simple, quiet unit that is great for students or a single working professional. Pets are allowed. No on-site parking. Short-term and month-to-month contracts are available. Near jeepney routes, sari-sari stores and a few cafés.

Fully furnished 3-bedroom apartment in East Bayan Park, Baguio City. It has a bright living area, a kitchen with a stove and refrigerator, and its own laundry space. Pets are allowed and there is an on-site parking area. Long-term and lease-to-own contracts are available. Near jeepney routes, sari-sari stores and schools.

Unfurnished 2-bedroom apartment in La Trinidad, Benguet. A roomy unit with a small balcony and a view of the valley. Pets are not allowed. Has an on-site parking area. Short-term and fixed-term contracts are available. Close to the strawberry farm, the town hall and Benguet State University.

Semi-furnished 2-bedroom apartment along Gov. Pack Road, Baguio City. It comes with beds, a dining set and a gas stove. Pets are allowed. No on-site parking. Month-to-month and fixed-term contracts are available. Walking distance to Session Road, Burnham Park and several universities.
Clean and quiet place. The owner was easy to talk to and fixed things quickly. Would rent here again.
Everything we needed was already there, so moving in took one afternoon. The parking slot is a big plus.
Small but cozy and very affordable. It gets a bit cold at night, so bring extra blankets.
Spacious and the furniture is nice, but the water pressure is weak in the mornings. The owner said it will be fixed soon.
Great view from the balcony. It\'s a bit far from the main road, so expect a longer commute.
Great location, I could walk to school. Some street noise during the day but quiet at night.
